description: This file extends the CanvasWindowController class with test methods used during debugging. These methods include utilities for sanitizing session keys, creating JavaScript string literals, storing and loading window frames, parsing IPv4 addresses, and determining network locality based on IP addresses. All methods are enclosed within a DEBUG conditional compilation block, indicating they are intended for testing purposes.

classes.name: CanvasWindowController
classes.description: An extension of CanvasWindowController providing testing utilities for session handling, URL processing, frame storage, and network address parsing.

methods.name: _testSanitizeSessionKey
methods.description: Sanitizes a session key string for testing purposes.

methods.name: _testJSStringLiteral
methods.description: Converts a string value into a JavaScript string literal for testing.

methods.name: _testJSOptionalStringLiteral
methods.description: Converts an optional string value into a JavaScript string literal, handling nil values, for testing.

methods.name: _testStoredFrameKey
methods.description: Generates a storage key for a window frame based on a session key.

methods.name: _testStoreAndLoadFrame
methods.description: Stores a window frame associated with a session key and then loads it to verify persistence.

methods.name: _testParseIPv4
methods.description: Parses a hostname string into its constituent IPv4 bytes, used for testing IPv4 parsing.

methods.name: _testIsLocalNetworkIPv4
methods.description: Determines if a given IPv4 address belongs to a local network.

methods.name: _testIsLocalNetworkCanvasURL
methods.description: Checks if a URL points to a local network resource using a specific handler.
